name: A Perfect Marriage
source:
David and Anna Parker are a lovely young, married couple with a newborn daughter.  Those that know them say they have the perfect marriage.  But jealousy and treachery will soon put their marriage to the test.  You will control their fate!

[From [url=https://palmermr.itch.io/a-perfect-marriage]Itch.io[/url]]

---

Loosely adapted from [url=https://www.literotica.com/s/how-to-ruin-a-perfect-marriage]How to Ruin a Perfect Marriage[/url] by TeamEquipe.
translation:
大卫·帕克和安娜·帕克是一对可爱的年轻已婚夫妇，他们有一个刚出生的女儿。认识他们的人都说他们的婚姻很完美。但嫉妒和背叛很快就会让他们的婚姻面临考验。你将掌控他们的命运！

[来自[url=https://palmermr.itch.io/a-perfect-marriage]Itch.io[/url]]
